name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: Build a lightweight “prompt health” dashboard that flags stale, unused, or low-value prompts in real time.

Why: It turns invisible maintenance into visible work. We’ll see which prompts are actually driving decisions, which are dead weight, and which need updates—so we stop wasting time on guesswork. The trade-off is upfront effort to wire the dashboard into our routing layer, but the payoff is faster, smarter pruning and clearer ownership.
